   476	def is_improvement(metric_name, change):
   477	    """Determine if change is improvement based on metric type"""
   478	    # Lower is better for these metrics

   484

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json

df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')

# ============================================================
# 1. EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW KPIs
# ============================================================
print("="*60)
print("EXECUTIVE OVERVIEW")
print("="*60)

# Overall averages
overall_avg_ai_risk = df['ai_risk_score'].mean()
overall_median_salary = df['salary'].median()
overall_avg_skill_demand = df['skill_demand_score'].mean()
total_job_openings_latest = df[df['year']==2035]['job_openings'].sum()

print(f"Overall avg AI risk: {overall_avg_ai_risk:.3f}")
print(f"Overall median salary: ${overall_median_salary:,.2f}")
print(f"Overall avg skill demand: {overall_avg_skill_demand:.1f}")
print(f"Total job openings 2035: {total_job_openings_latest:,.0f}")

# Job survival rate over time
survival_by_year = df.groupby('year').apply(
    lambda x: (x['job_survival_class'] >= 1).mean() * 100
).reset_index(name='survival_rate')
print("\nSurvival rate by year:")
print(survival_by_year.to_string(index=False))

# AI risk trend
ai_risk_by_year = df.groupby('year')['ai_risk_score'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nAI risk by year:")
print(ai_risk_by_year.to_string(index=False))

# Median salary trend
salary_by_year = df.groupby('year')['salary'].median().reset_index()
print("\nMedian salary by year:")
print(salary_by_year.to_string(index=False))

# ============================================================
# 2. AUTOMATION RISK LANDSCAPE
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("AUTOMATION RISK LANDSCAPE")
print("="*60)

# By job title
risk_by_job = df.groupby('job_title')['ai_risk_score'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAI Risk by Job Title:")
print(risk_by_job)

# By country
risk_by_country = df.groupby('country')['ai_risk_score'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAI Risk by Country:")
print(risk_by_country)

# By experience level
risk_by_exp = df.groupby('experience_level')['ai_risk_score'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAI Risk by Experience:")
print(risk_by_exp)

# Risk category distribution
risk_cat_dist = df['ai_risk_category'].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100
print("\nRisk Category Distribution:")
print(risk_cat_dist)

# By job title and year (trend)
risk_job_year = df.groupby(['job_title','year'])['ai_risk_score'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nRisk trend sample:")
print(risk_job_year[risk_job_year['job_title']=='Business Analyst'].tail())

# ============================================================
# 3. SALARY TRENDS
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("SALARY TRENDS")
print("="*60)

# Median salary by country
salary_by_country = df.groupby('country')['salary'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nMedian Salary by Country:")
print(salary_by_country)

# Median salary by job title
salary_by_job = df.groupby('job_title')['salary'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nMedian Salary by Job Title:")
print(salary_by_job)

# Median salary by experience
salary_by_exp = df.groupby('experience_level')['salary'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nMedian Salary by Experience:")
print(salary_by_exp)

# Median salary by education
salary_by_edu = df.groupby('education_level')['salary'].median().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nMedian Salary by Education:")
print(salary_by_edu)

# Salary vs AI Risk correlation
salary_risk_corr = df['salary'].corr(df['ai_risk_score'])
print(f"\nSalary vs AI Risk correlation: {salary_risk_corr:.3f}")

# Salary by risk category
salary_by_risk = df.groupby('ai_risk_category')['salary'].median()
print("\nMedian Salary by Risk Category:")
print(salary_by_risk)

# Salary bucket distribution over time
salary_bucket_year = df.groupby(['year','salary_bucket']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
salary_bucket_year_pct = salary_bucket_year.div(salary_bucket_year.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100
print("\nSalary Bucket % by Year:")
print(salary_bucket_year_pct.to_string())

# ============================================================
# 4. SKILLS DEMAND
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("SKILLS DEMAND")
print("="*60)

# Average skill demand by skill
skill_demand = df.groupby('primary_skill')['skill_demand_score'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAvg Skill Demand Score:")
print(skill_demand)

# Skill demand trend
skill_demand_year = df.groupby(['primary_skill','year'])['skill_demand_score'].mean().reset_index()
print("\nSkill demand trend sample (Python):")
print(skill_demand_year[skill_demand_year['primary_skill']=='Python'].tail())

# Skill vs survival
skill_survival = df.groupby('primary_skill')['job_survival_class'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAvg Job Survival by Skill:")
print(skill_survival)

# Skill vs AI risk
skill_risk = df.groupby('primary_skill')['ai_risk_score'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAvg AI Risk by Skill:")
print(skill_risk)

# ============================================================
# 5. JOB SURVIVAL OUTLOOK
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("JOB SURVIVAL OUTLOOK")
print("="*60)

# Survival class distribution
survival_dist = df['job_survival_class'].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index() * 100
print("\nSurvival Class Distribution:")
print(survival_dist)

# Survival by job title
survival_by_job = df.groupby('job_title')['job_survival_class'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAvg Survival by Job Title:")
print(survival_by_job)

# Survival by country
survival_by_country = df.groupby('country')['job_survival_class'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAvg Survival by Country:")
print(survival_by_country)

# Survival by education
survival_by_edu = df.groupby('education_level')['job_survival_class'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nAvg Survival by Education:")
print(survival_by_edu)

# Job openings trend
openings_by_year = df.groupby('year')['job_openings'].sum().reset_index()
print("\nTotal Job Openings by Year:")
print(openings_by_year.to_string(index=False))

# Job openings by title over time
openings_job_year = df.groupby(['job_title','year'])['job_openings'].sum().reset_index()
print("\nJob openings by title sample:")
print(openings_job_year[openings_job_year['job_title']=='AI Researcher'].tail())

# ============================================================
# 6. KEY INSIGHTS FOR RECOMMENDATIONS
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("KEY INSIGHTS FOR RECOMMENDATIONS")
print("="*60)

# Top 3 most at-risk jobs
print("\nTop 3 Most At-Risk Jobs:")
print(risk_by_job.head(3))

# Top 3 safest jobs
print("\nTop 3 Safest Jobs:")
print(risk_by_job.tail(3))

# Highest paying jobs
print("\nHighest Paying Jobs (median):")
print(salary_by_job.head(3))

# Lowest paying jobs
print("\nLowest Paying Jobs (median):")
print(salary_by_job.tail(3))

# Fastest growing skill demand (2024 vs 2035)
skill_2024 = df[df['year']==2024].groupby('primary_skill')['skill_demand_score'].mean()
skill_2035 = df[df['year']==2035].groupby('primary_skill')['skill_demand_score'].mean()
skill_growth = ((skill_2035 - skill_2024) / skill_2024 * 100).sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nSkill Demand Growth 2024->2035:")
print(skill_growth)

# Survival rate by education and experience
survival_combo = df.groupby(['education_level','experience_level'])['job_survival_class'].mean().unstack()
print("\nSurvival by Education & Experience:")
print(survival_combo)

# Save key data for charts
with open('/app/output/analysis_data.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump({
        'ai_risk_by_year': ai_risk_by_year.to_dict(orient='records'),
        'salary_by_year': salary_by_year.to_dict(orient='records'),
        'survival_by_year': survival_by_year.to_dict(orient='records'),
        'openings_by_year': openings_by_year.to_dict(orient='records'),
        'risk_by_job': risk_by_job.to_dict(),
        'salary_by_job': salary_by_job.to_dict(),
        'skill_demand': skill_demand.to_dict(),
        'survival_by_job': survival_by_job.to_dict(),
        'risk_by_country': risk_by_country.to_dict(),
        'salary_by_country': salary_by_country.to_dict(),
        'salary_by_risk': salary_by_risk.to_dict(),
        'salary_bucket_year_pct': salary_bucket_year_pct.to_dict(),
        'skill_growth': skill_growth.to_dict(),
        'survival_by_edu': survival_by_edu.to_dict(),
        'survival_by_exp': df.groupby('experience_level')['job_survival_class'].mean().to_dict(),
    }, f, indent=2, default=str)

print("\nAnalysis complete. Data saved to /app/output/analysis_data.json")
EOF

import pandas as pd

import json

df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')

risk_job_year = df.groupby(['job_title','year'])['ai_risk_score'].mean().reset_index()
risk_job_year_pivot = risk_job_year.pivot(index='year', columns='job_title', values='ai_risk_score')

# 2. Median Salary by Job Title over time
salary_job_year = df.groupby(['job_title','year'])['salary'].median().reset_index()
salary_job_year_pivot = salary_job_year.pivot(index='year', columns='job_title', values='salary')

# 3. Job openings by job title over time
openings_job_year = df.groupby(['job_title','year'])['job_openings'].sum().reset_index()
openings_job_year_pivot = openings_job_year.pivot(index='year', columns='job_title', values='job_openings')

# 4. Survival rate by job title over time
survival_job_year = df.groupby(['job_title','year']).apply(
    lambda x: (x['job_survival_class'] >= 1).mean() * 100, include_groups=False
).reset_index(name='survival_rate')
survival_job_year_pivot = survival_job_year.pivot(index='year', columns='job_title', values='survival_rate')

# 5. Skill demand by skill over time
skill_year = df.groupby(['primary_skill','year'])['skill_demand_score'].mean().reset_index()
skill_year_pivot = skill_year.pivot(index='year', columns='primary_skill', values='skill_demand_score')

# 6. Salary by risk category over time
salary_risk_year = df.groupby(['ai_risk_category','year'])['salary'].median().reset_index()
salary_risk_year_pivot = salary_risk_year.pivot(index='year', columns='ai_risk_category', values='salary')

# 7. Risk by country over time
risk_country_year = df.groupby(['country','year'])['ai_risk_score'].mean().reset_index()
risk_country_year_pivot = risk_country_year.pivot(index='year', columns='country', values='ai_risk_score')

# 8. Survival by country over time

    lambda x: (x['job_survival_class'] >= 1).mean() * 100, include_groups=False
).reset_index(name='survival_rate')
